name: shopfox-shopping
description: US shopping research with real prices, sellers, and purchase links. Ask for a product, get a complete report of 3-5 buyable picks from Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, and Target.

interface.shortDescription: Real prices, real stores, real links
interface.longDescription: Shopfox turns your AI into a shopping expert for US retailers. Ask in plain English and it researches live offers across Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, and Target, then returns a complete report: 3-5 top picks with current prices, ratings, pros and cons, and direct purchase links.
